name: @necodoc/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the necodoc /api/v1 API, generated from its OpenAPI document.

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @necodoc/api openapi "$PWD/openapi.json" && pnpm dlx --package=openapi-typescript@7.13.0 --package=typescript@6.0.3 openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/schema.ts && biome format --write src/schema.ts openapi.json
